summary: iter95x backend testing: scope-templates (GET/PUT, admin-only, default dedup, UUID assignment, ID preservation) + sites color field (POST/GET/PUT). 13/14 tests passed. 1 bug found: PUT /api/sites/{id} with color=null does NOT clear the color (backend filters None values).

minor.issue: Sending {"color": null} does NOT clear color field. /app/backend/routes/sites.py line 96 uses `{k: v for k, v in site_update.model_dump().items() if v is not None}` which strips all None values from the update payload, so null color is silently ignored. Spec requires PUT to accept null to clear. Fix: distinguish unset vs explicit None using model_dump(exclude_unset=True), e.g. `update_data = site_update.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)`. Same caveat applies to other nullable fields.

action_items: Fix PUT /api/sites/{id} to allow color=null clearing (use model_dump(exclude_unset=True) in routes/sites.py update_site)
critical_code_review_comments: routes/sites.py update_site: filters None via `if v is not None` => any nullable field can never be cleared via PUT. Switch to exclude_unset=True (Pydantic v2) to support explicit nulls while ignoring omitted fields.
wyceny.py scope-templates endpoints look clean: UUID auto-assign, default dedup, upsert. Good.
GET /api/sites now projects 'color' field; ConstructionSite model defines color Optional[str] => legacy sites return color=None correctly.

rca of the issue: RCA: routes/sites.py line 96 `{k: v for k, v in site_update.model_dump().items() if v is not None}` discards any field set to None in the PUT payload. Repro: 1) POST /api/sites with color=#3F5235, 2) PUT /api/sites/{id} body {"color": null}, 3) GET /api/sites returns color=#3F5235 (unchanged). Mitigation: change to `update_data = site_update.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` so only explicitly omitted fields are skipped, and explicit nulls reach Mongo `$set`.
